jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent animation source for horizontal 2D fighting game. Input image is ONLY the immutable identity/anatomy/costume reference, not a backdrop. Preserve the exact face, age, natural adult/young proportions, head size, shoulder width, hair, coat/skirt silhouette, ornaments and footwear. No big-head chibi or costume redesign. Compact clean cel sprite artwork with simple readable color blocks and a thin dark outline. True transparent alpha=0 outside characters, fully opaque character interiors. NO background gradient, halo, floor shadow, light rays, labels or grid. Camera locked right-facing side combat view throughout, slight face angle allowed but no frontal torso. All poses have the same anatomical scale and nominal foot-root system. Do not duplicate/rotate/scale an idle to simulate motion. BODY ONLY; no weapons, assistants, effects or opponents baked into character. Hands must express believable grip/gesture with anatomically correct fingers for later independent layers. FOUR distinct full-body chronological poses: preparation, onset, effective action, recovery. Layout a TWO-by-TWO grid, row-major. Critical: reserve a completely empty transparent 100-pixel horizontal gutter BETWEEN ROWS and 100-pixel vertical gutter BETWEEN COLUMNS, plus at least 15% empty transparent margins inside EVERY cell. Characters may occupy at most 70% of cell height. Entire hair, horns/hat, clothes, feet and fingertips must stay inside their own cell. NEVER let upper-row shoes overlap lower-row hair, NEVER cross the center dividers. Movement/changing stance changes silhouette but not the underlying body/head scale. Character: furina. Identity/performance: 舞台表演气质：自信指挥与被打断后的慌忙收势；不擅自编造剧情事实. This is a project fighting-game adaptation, not a claim of original game animation. Action light3: 侧身指挥蟹低钳：准备→出手→有效→恢复，具体身体四姿待标定. Translate the stated choreography into FOUR genuinely different consecutive poses; preserve preparation, contact/release intent and recovery with grounded weight. Empty grip hands stand in for independently produced weapons.  Furina remains empty-handed elegant commander; the crab Crabaletta, octopus Usher and seahorse Chevalmarin are separate unique assistant layers, not in this body sheet. No generic sword stance.
